lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
Since needs have plus a verb.
Have lived! I have lived here since 2020.

data.why: Since needs have plus a verb.

en.tip: Use present perfect with since. Say “I have lived here since 2020”.
en.caption: Do you say “I live here since 2020”? 😅 Since means from then until now, so use the present perfect. “I have lived here since 2020” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
